Use the supplied portrait as visible face and hair guidance: a soft oval face, large dark-brown eyes, a straight nose and softly defined pink lips; a dark jaw-length bob with a lightly separated fringe. Her ink-blue square-neck linen dress and warm reflected light give her a quiet, attractive presence while her attention stays on the work. She stands beside a waist-high handwheel at the open edge of a limestone loggia, her torso angled comfortably toward it. Her right hand grips the upper rim and her left hand steadies the lower rim, both elbows bent with room beside her body. Frame her from mid-thigh upward, placing her face and handwheel prominently in the foreground and the complete short drive linkage along the right side. Include the low canopy above and the table behind within the same readable depth. Crisp noon light makes the moving shade boundary graphic; soft reflected stone light retains the reference face's form and the hands' contact.
